actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /app
printf '== qemu/nginx checks ==\n'
command -v qemu-system-i386 || true
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || true
command -v nginx || true
printf '\n== image info ==\n'
file /app/isos/win311.img || true
printf '\n== existing files ==\n'
find /app -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^/app/##' | sort | head -200

next_steps: Inspect image format and any existing launch artifacts
Implement a wrapper that starts QEMU snapshot mode with VNC :1 and a keyboard-control channel if possible
